description_zh: 自动驾驶车辆在右转过程中因地图误差过于靠近路侧，与右侧停放的车辆发生侧镜擦碰。选用 ego 右转接近路边静止障碍的 static_block 表达，lateral=0.1 还原侧镜接触距离。

source_snippets: The AV was making a right turn along the Kingsbury Cir, traveling at 16 mph.

Due to an inaccurate map version downloaded on the AV causing the AV to drive close to the parked vehicles on the side of the street... the right side sensor pod of the AV made contact with the left side rear view mirror of a passenger vehicle parked on the side.
WEATHER: CLOUDY; LIGHTING: DARK – STREET LIGHTS
evidence.reason: 移动的 AV 作为 ego (右转 16 mph≈7.15 m/s)；对方车辆静止在路侧，使用 static/roadside/static_block，依据侧镜接触设置 lateral=0.1。天气 cloudy、黄昏时段，无交通控制设施。符合支持条件。
